mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal perfusion and increase serum potassium; dorzolamide inhibits carbonic anhydrase leading to metabolic effects while losartan blocks angiotensin II-mediated potassium excretion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium) and renal function periodically; assess blood pressure stability; consider alternative to dorzolamide if hyperkalemia or renal dysfunction develops.
